text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gas explosion kills six and wounds five in a residential area of Casablanca.
- Morocco considers splitting into 16 regions to ensure a better distribution of resources.

- During parliamentary session communications minister found it difficult to persuade MPs of the need for an additional electricity tax to help loss-making private TV channel 2M straighten out its finances.
- Finance minister visits Spain to discuss debt conversion.
- Morocco launched an international tender to build a port in the northern city of Tangier.
- Privatisation minister says restructuring state-owned companies needs long-term political will.
- King Hassan recent meeting with leaders of political parties shows he opts for a more direct way to go ahead with reforms.
